info.name: AIS_SYSTEM demo (UNVERIFIED)
info.description:
UNVERIFIED — generated from unexecuted source at 8e4a0ed; run against a JSON-mode server first (see DEMO_GUIDE.md).

Run the folders in order, once, against a server on a FRESH runtime (docs/DEMO_GUIDE.md section 2). Re-running on the same runtime gives 409 duplicates and wrong ids. Postman's cookie jar keeps the AIS_SESSION cookie; only one user is signed in at a time, and each 'Login as ...' replaces the previous session. Set passwords as CURRENT values only (never initial values) so they are not exported. Login limit: 5 attempts per IP+email and 30 per IP in 15 minutes; this collection logs in 9 times in total (admin 2, registrar 3, faculty 1, student 2, student2 1). Contract: docs/FRONTEND_API.md.

GRADES: start the server with APP_GRADE_SCALE=demo (the demo-only scale 1.00, 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00, 2.25, 2.50, 2.75, 3.00, 5.00, INC, DRP; NOT the official university policy). Folders 7 and 8 expect success in that mode. The collection variable grade_scale_mode (demo or off) only selects what the one OPTIONAL request in folder 7 asserts; it does not configure the server. With the default server (APP_GRADE_SCALE unset or off), grade entry and corrections return 409 grade_scale and folders 7-8 are expected to fail except that optional request.
